# DesktopView

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/logic/player/player.h`](../../../src/logic/player/player.h) · Described in `data/player.json`

The desktop camera sits at this player's eyes.

## Notes

Read by PlayerViewpoint; the viewer's MouseKeyboardInput and ControllersInput systems feed the DesktopView player, and PlayerControl does nothing while an entity has one.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: ControllersInput, MouseKeyboardInput, PlayerControl, PlayerViewpoint. Written by: PlayerSpawn. Created by: PlayerSpawn. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ControllersInput](../systems/ControllersInput.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | the player whose devices these are |
| [MouseKeyboardInput](../systems/MouseKeyboardInput.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | the player whose devices these are |
| [PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | any entity with it (a physical player) owns the camera: the system does nothing |
| [PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md) | system | Host | **write+create** | init (makeFPSPlayer) | the desktop camera follows the FPS player |
| [PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | the player the camera follows |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ControllersInput](../systems/ControllersInput.md)**
  - SDL_InitSubSystem(SDL_INIT_GAMECONTROLLER) in preinit (not in captures and probes), SDL_QuitSubSystem in finish.
  - Looks for a gamepad every second while none is open (SDL_GameControllerOpen), closes it when detached and in finish.
- **[MouseKeyboardInput](../systems/MouseKeyboardInput.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while captured (every tick); ImGui's NoMouse config flag set while captured; both undone in finish.
- **[PlayerControl](../systems/PlayerControl.md)**
  - SDL_SetRelativeMouseMode on while the right mouse button is held, off otherwise (not touched while a DesktopView player exists).
  - The fly speed (30 m/s, x1.25 / x0.8 a wheel notch, 1 to 2000) is a function-static shared by every instance.
- **[PlayerSpawn](../systems/PlayerSpawn.md)**
  - Creates entities: the player (and its two hands for VR) and `props` box entities in init; one Ground entity in preinit with `ground: true`.
  - No physics bodies itself: RigidBody (a later system) makes the Jolt bodies of the RigidBody components it adds.
- **[PlayerViewpoint](../systems/PlayerViewpoint.md)**
  - None beyond the context variables.
